modules.recordEvent: renderer/app.js globals. sendLedgerEvent(ev) is the ONLY call of host.appendLedgerEvent in the renderer: it awaits the result, on { ok:false } calls toast(`Ledger event not recorded: ${errors.join('; ')}`, 'error') (toast is app.js:60) and returns the result. async recordEvent(kind, fields) -> sendLedgerEvent({ kind, by: A.user, ...fields }) for designc kinds (LS-01). async recordSessionEvent(kind, { session_id, payload, parent_session_id, agent_id, acting_as }) -> sendLedgerEvent({ kind, project: A.cfg.project || <basename of A.root>, session_id, payload, ...lineage }) for harness kinds (LS-02). agent.js (loaded after app.js, shares globals) uses them too.

contract.envelope_dispatch: Two envelopes, one store (R-1). A kind is in exactly one of KINDS (designc, snake_case, 15) or HARNESS_KINDS (harness, PascalCase, 15); the sets are disjoint (R-3). Write: kind in KINDS -> Ledger.validate (designc v1 rules); kind in HARNESS_KINDS -> Ledger.validateHarness; neither -> error 'unknown kind'. A designc kind carrying envelope_version, or a harness kind carrying schema_version, is rejected. Read (parse): a line with envelope_version -> harness path (never upcast); a line with schema_version -> designc v1 path; a line with both -> error 'both schema_version and envelope_version'; a line with neither -> designc legacy upcast.

harness_envelope.source: C:/Users/fialhomi/.claude/harness/event.py (envelope v1, adopted as-is by grill-me D16). Pattern only; ported to JS, no Python at runtime or in tests.
harness_envelope.fields: HARNESS_FIELDS, all present on every written line: envelope_version (1), kind, project, session_id, event_id, ts, parent_session_id, agent_id, acting_as, pack_id, pack_version, harness_version, image_digest, snapshot_hash, payload
harness_envelope.required_from_caller: kind in HARNESS_KINDS; project: non-empty string (event.py:246-248); session_id: string; payload: object (may be {})
harness_envelope.optional_from_caller: parent_session_id, agent_id, acting_as: string or null. pack_id, pack_version, harness_version, image_digest, snapshot_hash: null (stubs; event.py STUB_FIELDS).
harness_envelope.stamped_by_store: envelope_version 1; event_id = crypto.randomUUID() if absent; ts = ISO-8601 UTC at seconds precision with '+00:00' suffix (event.py:129-131 utc_now) if absent; every absent nullable field set to null
harness_envelope.serialisation: JSON.stringify with keys sorted (event.py:269-272 to_json sort_keys), one line, appended to ledger/sessions.jsonl
harness_envelope.rejects: unknown top-level field (event.py:275-288); kind not in HARNESS_KINDS; empty project; non-string session_id; non-object payload; envelope_version other than 1; ts present but not a string that Date.parse accepts (designc strictness: _ts depends on it); failure without evidence (below)
harness_envelope.failure_evidence: Port of records_a_failure/has_failure_evidence (event.py:156-200): GateFailed and ActionErrored always record a failure; VerifyResult does when payload.verdict (trimmed, lower-cased) is in fail|failed|partial|error|blocked, or payload.exit_code is an integer other than 0. Such a record needs one of payload.reason|verify_failures|failures|gate_errors|issues non-empty (non-blank string, or non-empty array/object), or a non-blank payload.reason_unavailable.
harness_envelope.kinds: HARNESS_KINDS = SessionStarted, SessionEnded, ContextCompiled, ProposalMade, GatePassed, GateFailed, NeedsDecision, ActionExecuted, ActionErrored, VerifyResult, BudgetExceeded, HumanDecision, Done (charter) + NoteRecorded, WorkRecorded (local) — event.py:49-96. Pinned by test: a literal list, plus a drift check against event.py when that file exists on the machine (skipped otherwise, so CI never needs it).
harness_envelope.resolution: resolvedEventIds(events) -> Set of payload.cites_event_id over HumanDecision events (port of event.py:291-307). Harness NeedsDecision is resolved ONLY this way; derive() does not fold harness records.

contract.ts_in_memory: R-2. Each envelope keeps its own ts on disk (designc: epoch-ms number; harness: ISO string). parse() adds _ts (epoch ms number) to EVERY loaded event: designc -> ts if a number else 0; harness -> Date.parse(ts). derive() preserves _ts. Every sort or time filter over ledger events uses _ts: core.js:390 latestCheck and app.js:984 improveDash escape sort become (b._ts || 0) - (a._ts || 0).
contract.gate_scope: R-4. 'Pipeline-sourced needs-decision' (grill-me D16) = designc-envelope kind needs_decision. The gate (core.js:385) counts only kind === 'needs_decision' && status === 'open', which already excludes harness NeedsDecision; the filter is unchanged and a test pins that an open harness NeedsDecision leaves the gate ready. needs_decision is resolved by needs_decision_resolved{id} (derive); NeedsDecision by HumanDecision{payload.cites_event_id} (resolvedEventIds).

envelope.event_id: string; stamped by the store with crypto.randomUUID(); legacy lines get 'legacy:<file>:<line>' at read time
envelope.ts: number (epoch ms); stamped as now() when absent; MUST be numeric (core.js:390 and app.js:984 sort with b.ts - a.ts)
envelope.optional: system (S1|S2|S3|S4), stage (emitting stage, MAF meaning), run_id, trace_id, session, requirement, element, decision, task, model, tokens_in (int>=0), tokens_out (int>=0), cost (number>=0), sample (boolean), payload (object, unvalidated)
envelope.on_disk: absent optional fields are omitted, not null-stubbed; keys beginning with '_' are reserved for in-memory decoration (_file, _line, _legacy) and are rejected on write

contract.caught_by: CAUGHT_BY = ['S1-lint','S1-p','S1-grill','S2-runtime','S2-config'] — the keys of STAGES in renderer/app.js:25 must equal this list
contract.append_signature: appendEvent(root, event, { now = Date.now, uuid = crypto.randomUUID } = {}) -> { ok: true, event } | { ok: false, errors: string[] }. Order: Ledger.validate(event) (schema_version/event_id/ts may be absent) -> stamp -> file = path.join(root, 'ledger', KINDS[kind].stream) -> mkdir -p -> ONE JSON.stringify -> ONE fs.promises.appendFile(line + '\n'). No caller-supplied path. Never reads, rewrites or truncates.
contract.ipc: main.js: ipcMain handle 'ledger:event' (event) -> store.appendEvent(<registry root>, event). preload.js: appendLedgerEvent: (ev) => ipcRenderer.invoke('ledger:event', ev).
contract.validation_errors: Each error is a string naming the field, e.g. "check.exit_code: required when outcome is 'fail' (or give reason)". validate rejects: unknown kind; missing required field; enum violation; wrong type (incl. non-numeric ts); unknown top-level field (extra data must go under payload); '_'-prefixed key; schema_version other than 1 when present; kind rule breach.
contract.parse: Ledger.parse(text, path) -> { events, errors }. Per non-blank line: invalid JSON -> error; envelope_version present -> harness path from LS-02 (see envelope_dispatch; valid -> loaded, invalid -> error, skipped; unknown envelope_version -> error, skipped); no schema_version -> upcast, _legacy:true, loaded; schema_version 1 and valid -> loaded; schema_version 1 and invalid -> error, skipped; any other schema_version -> error 'unknown schema_version N', skipped. Every loaded event gets _file (basename), _line (1-based) and, from LS-02, _ts (ts_in_memory). errors are { path, line, msg } — the same shape A.ledgerErrors already holds (app.js:94-104), so the Problems panel (R20) is unchanged.
contract.upcast: In memory only, files never rewritten. Adds schema_version 1 and event_id 'legacy:<file>:<line>'; keeps ts (never invents one); applies the per-kind rename table active in that slice; moves any key not in the kind's spec into payload; does NOT apply v1 kind rules (a legacy check fail without exit_code still loads, so the gate never loses a legacy check). Final rename table: escape rule->code, stage->caught_by; escape_classified stage->caught_by; agent_turn stopReason->stop_reason, runId->run_id, via inferred ('acp' if stopReason present, and then tokens->context_used; 'agui' if model starts with 'agui:'; else 'builtin'); agent_tool and agent_permission toolKind->tool_kind; unapproved_change unchanged.
contract.derive: Ledger.derive(events) -> events. Same semantics as deriveLedger (app.js:106-118): fold escape_classified.caught_by onto escape.caught_by (matching escape.id === escape_classified.escape); needs_decision_resolved sets needs_decision.status='resolved'; last in file order wins; the two fold kinds are removed from the output.
contract.total_tokens: Ledger.totalTokens(ev) = ev.tokens if a number, else (tokens_in||0)+(tokens_out||0) if either is a number, else 0
contract.legacy_fixture: sample-registry/ledger/pipeline.jsonl is the v0 fixture (21 lines, all sample:true). Tests read it; no task edits it.
contract.no_new_dependencies: No new npm dependencies in any task (package.json dependencies/devDependencies unchanged).
